michelangelo_a1_anchor.regression: RANGE / decomposition check — NOT a deterministic point-match. 2,393 is ONE observed hit that may include game damage variance and a specific conditional-mastery state, so the model must NOT be forced to output exactly 2,393. The check is: the BOOKED normal-hit prediction interval (per hit) = 2.0xATK x 0.80(aff) x 1.20(book) x mastery(1.113-1.202) x defM(0.5135) = [2226, 2405] must CONTAIN 2,393, and each term of the decomposition must match its source value.
michelangelo_a1_anchor.weak_note: 1940/2393 = 0.81 vs the sim's 0.70 weak-hit ratio. The cause is NOT yet determined — it could be damage variance, hit order, OR mastery state. Retained as a paired soft observation only; NOT required to match until real per-hit variance + the exact per-hit state are reproduced. Do not name the cause.
